name: Shochiku Co., Ltd.
summary: Shochiku Co., Ltd. engages in audio and video, theatre, real estate, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through Video-related business, Theater Business, Real Estate Business, and Other segments. The company is involved in the production, sales, distribution, and exhibition of theatrical films, operation of movie theater concession stands, and licensing of video rights, produces and sells TV movie, commercial planning and production, BS/CS/CATV software production and editing, tar-based and general broadcasting, production, acquisition and sales of video software, planning and production agency for advertising, music writing.
